title: HMNZS Southland followed by an 800-foot USO
place_text: at sea, New Zealand navy ship

tellings.quote: New Zealand ship in the 1980s, the HMNZS Southland, had an 800- foot-long USO following it,

plain: In the 1980s a New Zealand navy ship, the HMNZS Southland, was followed by an unidentified underwater object about 800 feet long, what researchers call a USO, an unidentified submerged object. A researcher named Kevin Knuth mentions it to Michels in passing, without naming his source. If true, it would mean something huge and unknown moving under the sea alongside a warship.
